axes.contextual_translation: Unscored until the repository contains certified contextual-translation gold.
axes.ownership_geometry: Checks exact-occurrence geometry facts and their appearance dispositions through the effective certification trail.
axes.structured_hover: Checks exact projection-to-fact parity and derived appearance bindings for the currently certified p007 pilot facts; historical review-required facts and candidate payload prose remain excluded.
axes.tutor: Replays quarantined placement probes through the ordinary tutor grader for accepted-answer, forbidden-answer, required-reason and two-vote-hold behavior; this is runtime contract coverage, not learner performance.

limitations: Version 1 measures authority integrity and deterministic ordinary-runtime replay, not unconstrained model or learner accuracy.
A perfect axis score means that the frozen certified facts or runtime probes passed their bounded contracts; it does not imply corpus completion or learner capability.
No aggregate score is defined because the axes have different denominators and evidence postures.
purpose: Provide a deterministic train-over-train baseline for segmentation ownership, structured hover projection parity, contextual translation readiness, and ordinary tutor runtime behavior.
